api.validate: validate(definition, blackboard): strict extra IR and expression validation
api.start: start(unit, stateBuff, definition, blackboard, time, buffIndex): resolve extras into existing clientProgramState.buffs item
api.advance: advance(unit,time): emit due finite cost actions with serialized count/cursor before parent expiry; uses onSkillDp
api.effective: effective(unit,time): return live resolved derived candidates; do not call ClientPrograms.layers; Aura merges before one shared override selection
api.stop: No separate lifecycle. Existing stop/death deletes clientProgramState; effective checks parent, skillState, owner immediately.

rootHooks: ClientPrograms validate/start/advance call module, retaining existing root Buff modifiers and lifetime.
ClientPrograms.absorb consumes stateBuff.damageBlockOnce once, sets only own buff until=time; sibling DEF continues.
Aura.effective merges SelfBuffs.effective candidates before shared override selection. Child never enters ordinary self modifier loop.
ClientPrograms.defensePenetration reads addition-only def_penetrate_fixed and def_penetrate; shared physical damage applies ratio before all fixed penetration.
index loads module before ClientPrograms. No new provider/engine per-ID dispatch.

schema.controller: cast_skill_active_buffs; pre_delay=0; preserve uninterruptibleOnAbilityPredelay boolean. Positive pre-delay is rejected, not needed by this group.

boundaries: Serialized fields/enum IDs are Verified; local runtime tests will not prove original client behavior.
JP cached graph with CN levels remains cross-snapshot Inferred.
All four actual ActiveBuffAbility preDelay values are zero. A differing uninterruptible-on-pre-delay bool does not create a positive delay.
Liskam source skill duration=-1 is not an infinite root Buff: both finite root Buffs resolve BB.duration=8.
BlockDamage event10 plus FinishBuff exact graph proves source sequence; simulation uses current shared positive-incoming damage phase and shield ordering. No new native no-dynamic branch claim.

Derived status_resistance[inf] ends with its parent; same overrideKey as Ceylon Aura is selected once, not multiplied twice. DEFAULT priority tie/source grouping uses existing explicit Aura simulation policy.
DEF penetration ratio-before-fixed and damage-time live attribute lookup extend current physical damage model; native complete order is not newly recovered.

Finite trigger interval/count are source fields with BB binding inferred from existing schema and full-level descriptions; runtime schedules first tick at interval when waitFirst=true, excludes ticks at/after parent expiry, preserves emitted count across save/restore.
onSkillDp remains the battle deployment-cost sink. Cost actions do not stop basic attacks. Display-only ModifyCost flags are retained; native precise frame/accounting order is not claimed.
validationPlan: Compile all scope without ID allowlists, retain unknown siblings/fields as whole-candidate rejections.
All 40 source levels: duration/DEF/block independence; derived status + same-group Aura; fixed/ratio physical damage; finite DP total and continued attacks.
Reject unknown action siblings, unsupported event order, modified source/owner fields, invalid penetration domains, positive pre-delay, nonintegral/negative counts and invalid intervals.
Actual available season ordinary/elite selection only; expanded-only members use source setup and are not reported as ordinary shop membership.
Host restore active/end/cursor: no repeated block, duplicate child, double recovery or expired modifiers.
